title: Grokbot Icon Studio
brief: A minimal bot-icon studio — browse bot icon examples and copy a prompt to generate an icon of your own. Quick asset generation for bot projects.
details: A small one-job Rege Lab tool ("Grokbot Icon · Minimal bot icons") that turns your favorite character into a little minimal bot icon. Copy the prompt (both versions use the original Korean text), attach your character's image in an image-generation tool, and send — the studio recommends ChatGPT, noting it worked well even on the free plan, while other tools (especially Grok) may not capture the intended style.
